signature.public_key: Externally pinned 44-byte SPKI DER; single publisher binding

manifest.encoding: canonical sorted compact UTF-8 JSON; exact field set
manifest.approval: Authenticated host approval of exact manifest SHA-256 and expiry; not client JSON

package.type: single-disk ZIP, stored regular files only

persistence.scope: trusted local Linux host, one subject and fixed policy
persistence.fresh_initialization: only when both component markers and every signed_skill_* table are absent
persistence.incomplete_marked_schema: reject without recreating missing tables or policy singleton
persistence.policy_singleton: exactly one id=1 row with persisted policy, valid last_time and suspension state
persistence.event_sequence: AUTOINCREMENT retained and included in continuity digest
persistence.runtime_policy: subject, key map, capability/domain policy, clock, capacity, transparency verifier and state anchor are read-only constructor bindings
persistence.clock_error: ordinary host-clock exceptions and invalid values reduce to fixed skill_clock_invalid without private exception cause
persistence.unknown_namespaced_table: reject in both fresh and established state
persistence.authority_digest: domain-separated typed SHA-256 over the five authority tables and event AUTOINCREMENT sequence
persistence.transaction_seal: verify before authority use; compare-and-update after mutation in the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction
persistence.optional_host_anchor: exact instance/revision/digest lower bound; client JSON is not authority
persistence.object_binding: hold O_NOFOLLOW parent-directory and regular-file descriptors from before sqlite3.connect until SQLite close
persistence.sqlite_connection: open through /proc/self/fd/<held-file-fd>; first object/path/ctime check occurs before PRAGMA or schema write
persistence.path_identity: held object, parent-relative entry and absolute configured path must identify the same inode before, inside and after transactions
persistence.open_interval_aba: initial file and parent-directory ctime mismatch rejects A-to-B-to-A substitution before authority writes
persistence.filesystem_owner: the final parent directory and primary database file must be owned by the effective service uid
persistence.filesystem_write_mode: owner read/write is required; the final parent also requires owner search; group/world write bits are rejected and rechecked around transactions
persistence.filesystem_permission_failure: fail with skill_registry_database_permissions_invalid before authority use or migration
persistence.filesystem_boundary: POSIX ACLs, Linux capabilities, ancestor-directory and mount trust, hostile-kernel behavior and confidentiality/read policy are not established by these mode-bit checks
persistence.platform_fallback: absence of O_NOFOLLOW, /proc/self/fd or effective-uid support fails closed; no pathname-only fallback
persistence.legacy_upgrade: explicit offline object-bound migrate_signed_skills_v1 with the same owner/write checks; no automatic migration or source proof of old-process drain

revocation.at_capacity: atomically suspend registry; never evict existing denials
revocation.clock_failure: denial remains available using last observed audit time

verification.continuity_deep_check: startup and state_checkpoint; schema and authority digest on every registry transaction

transparency.configuration: optional exact built-in verifier whose complete inclusion/consistency/witness policy digest is persisted
transparency.manifest_binding: RFC6962 inclusion leaf is exact canonical manifest bytes
transparency.consistency_floor: optional immutable log ID/tree size/root with RFC6962 consistency verification
transparency.witness_quorum: optional immutable Ed25519 witness identity/key quorum over exact checkpoint hash and root
transparency.legacy_binding: unchanged when advanced consistency/witness policy is absent
transparency.stored_installation_expiry: also bounded by checkpoint, log-key, witness-statement and witness-key expiry

migration.mode: explicit offline additive transaction through the same held object-bound connection
migration.failure: rollback continuity table, marker and all migration writes
migration.path_replacement_or_aba: reject without migrating a replacement or wrong inode
migration.filesystem_permissions: effective-uid ownership and exclusive mode-bit write custody are required and reported; no repair or chmod is performed

not_implemented: operated append-only log, authenticated proof retrieval, dynamic checkpoint persistence, cross-client gossip, split-view detection or proof of witness-operator independence
proof that legacy processes were stopped before migration
POSIX ACL, Linux capability, ancestor-directory or mount-policy verification
atomicity between SQLite commit and arbitrary post-check pathname changes
claim_ceiling: Repository source implementation and tests only. Object-bound local continuity, Unix ownership/mode checks and optional host-anchor checks are not independent anti-rollback, E5-E7, global log honesty, general execution permission or full HG-0087/skills closure.
